paper_title: Axion mass prediction from adaptive mesh refinement cosmological lattice simulations
coupling_convention: m_a in eV (QCD axion mass prediction, not an exclusion limit)
notes: This paper predicts the QCD axion DM mass (m_a ~ 45-65 ueV from strings, potentially up to ~300 ueV including domain-wall production) from cosmological lattice simulations. It is a theoretical mass prediction, not a measured or projected exclusion limit on a coupling constant. No (mass, coupling) exclusion data points are provided; the results are on axion mass ranges only, not on the f_a-m_a exclusion plane in a form yielding tabulated coupling limits. Therefore no extractable exclusion data points. | [CONVENTION REVIEW] declared coupling convention 'm_a in eV (QCD axion mass prediction, not an exclusion limit)' is not canonical and has no vetted auto-conversion; needs human review
